name: awf
description: Agentic workflow skills: request a structured, language-agnostic code review of an exact change and resolve its findings with evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Request a structured code review and resolve its findings
interface.longDescription: Pin the exact change, gather intent and constraints, and dispatch an independent read-only reviewer that reports separate verdicts and evidence-backed findings, then verify each finding against the current code and fix only what holds up.
defaultPrompt: Review my changes since main against the spec.
Work through the review findings on this branch.
